badge.text: Parents: 90% of our students show improved grades within 3 months

sections.title: Why Parents Choose Kidato
sections.description: Join parents who trust us with their children's education. Here's how we support your child's learning journey:

features.title: Safe Learning Environment
features.description: Your child connects with verified, background-checked tutors in a monitored online environment designed with child safety as the priority.

features.title: Personalized Attention
features.description: Watch your child thrive with individualized support that addresses their specific learning needs, pace, and interests.

features.title: Curriculum-Aligned Learning
features.description: All sessions are designed to complement your child's school curriculum, ensuring they excel in their regular academic studies.

features.title: Global Perspective
features.description: Expose your child to diverse perspectives as they connect with world-class tutors and peers from across the globe while focusing on African curriculum.

features.title: Progress Tracking
features.description: Receive regular updates on your child's development with detailed progress reports and achievement milestones.

sections.content: Our mission is to empower your child with quality education that builds confidence, sparks curiosity, and prepares them for future success - all while giving you peace of mind.

sections.title: Featured Educators
sections.subtitle: Meet our highly-rated teachers who are making a difference in students' lives across Africa

members.name: Dr. Sarah Okafor
members.bio: Joining Kidato transformed my teaching career. I now connect with motivated students from across Africa, set my own schedule, and earn a reliable income doing what I love.

members.name: Mr. Taiwo Makinde
members.bio: I specialize in teaching coding to beginners and advanced students. My passion is making complex programming concepts accessible to learners of all ages.

members.name: Ms. Nneka Okonkwo
members.bio: With a background in journalism and creative writing, I help students develop strong communication skills and a love for literature that will serve them throughout their lives.

members.name: Mr. Kofi Mensah
members.bio: I bring science to life through practical experiments and real-world applications. My students learn to observe, question, and understand the natural world around them.

sections.title: How Kidato Works for Teachers
sections.description: Our platform empowers educators to reach students across Africa with just a few simple steps

steps.title: Create Your Profile
steps.description: Build your teaching profile highlighting your expertise, qualifications, and teaching style to stand out to students and parents across Africa.

steps.title: Connect & Grow
steps.description: Build your professional network, join specialized teaching communities, and access continuous development opportunities.

steps.title: Teach & Earn
steps.description: Deliver engaging virtual lessons, build your reputation, and create flexible income streams while making a real impact on students' lives.

benefits.title: Professional Growth
benefits.description: Access specialized training and certification programs to enhance your teaching skills and advance your career.

benefits.title: Global Classroom
benefits.description: Connect with students across Africa without geographical limitations, expanding your teaching reach beyond borders.

benefits.title: Recognition & Rewards
benefits.description: Build your reputation through student reviews, ratings, and our teacher recognition program celebrating educational excellence.

benefits.title: Teaching Resources
benefits.description: Access our library of curriculum-aligned materials, interactive tools, and lesson templates to enhance your teaching.
